releases.body:
First release. It gives an OpenCode agent a way to stop its own subagents and keep them stopped, send a running subagent new instructions, see what's still running, and check what one is doing. It also tells the agent when one of its subagents has been stuck on a permission prompt for a while.

Needs OpenCode 2.2 or later. Install it with `opencode plugin add opencode-subagent-intervene`, and see the README for the details.
